test_title: PYST 59: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Mudit starts from Point Y and drives 92 km towards South. He then takes a left turn, drives 59 km, turns left and drives 38 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 28 km. He then turns left, drives 54 km to stop at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again?

(All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution: **Given:** Mudit starts from Point Y and: Drives 92 km towards South Takes a left turn and drives 59 km Takes a left turn and drives 38 km Takes a right turn and drives 28 km Takes a left turn and drives 54 km to reach Point Z
